rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Tanya
rows.Origin:
Bred by Maurice Combe (France, before 1959).
Introduced in France by Vilmorin-Andrieux in 1959 as 'Majeure'.
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (Newark, NY) in 1960 as 'Tanya'.
Introduced in Australia by Hazlewood Bros. Pty. Ltd. in 1961 as 'Majeure'.
Introduced in Australia by Better Roses (Australia) in 1962 as 'Tanya'.
rows.Bloom: Orange to peach, golden-yellow highlights. Apricot-orange. Moderate fragrance. 48 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Glossy, leathery foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 1,712 on 27 May 1958 VIEW USPTO PATENT
